{
  "_about": "The battle spells. What each one does is code, picked by \"kind\"; every number is here. A description fills in {magnitude%}, {magnitude}, {duration}, {range} and {selfHeal%} from the spell's own numbers, so the text cannot drift from the game.",
  "spells": [
    { "kind": "Heal", "name": "Heal", "cooldown": 46.6667, "magnitude": 0.30, "range": 6, "manaShare": 0.7,
      "description": "Restores {magnitude%} of max health to you and the most hurt ally nearby, and some mana." },
    { "kind": "Flicker", "name": "Flicker", "cooldown": 60, "magnitude": 7.2,
      "_magnitude": "Blink distance, scaled with every other reach in the game on 2026-10-09.",
      "description": "Blinks a short distance in the direction you are facing." },
    { "kind": "Retribution", "name": "Retribution", "cooldown": 23.3333, "magnitude": 600, "range": 4, "monsterHealthShare": 0.34, "selfHeal": 0.10,
      "_range": "Left at four. Doubling it was tried to make the coven stealable and measured as almost nothing: prowlers are not at the fight, their arm is not short.",
      "description": "Deals {magnitude} true damage plus a share of a monster's health, and restores {selfHeal%} of your health." },
    { "kind": "Execute", "name": "Execute", "cooldown": 50, "magnitude": 0.16, "range": 14,
      "_range": "One reach for everyone. At 6, 96% of carriers died holding it; at 14, 1.6 -> 6.9 casts a match, carriers' win rates within noise (2026-10-10).",
      "description": "Deals true damage equal to {magnitude%} of an enemy hero's missing health." },
    { "kind": "Sprint", "name": "Sprint", "cooldown": 40, "magnitude": 0.40, "duration": 2.6667,
      "description": "Grants {magnitude%} move speed for {duration} seconds." },
    { "kind": "Purify", "name": "Purify", "cooldown": 53.3333, "duration": 1, "haste": 0.3,
      "description": "Removes stuns and slows, and grants a burst of speed." }
  ],
  "_roles": "The second spell each role carries next to Heal. Two choices are a coin flip at match start; one is fixed.",
  "roles": {
    "West": ["Flicker", "Sprint"],
    "Prowler": ["Retribution"],
    "Center": ["Flicker", "Execute"],
    "Adc": ["Execute", "Flicker"],
    "Support": ["Purify", "Sprint"]
  }
}

  "summary": "A duelist who fights hardest beside his minions, and whose ultimate resets everything if all five strikes land.",

  "personality": "Overconfident in his own abilities. Young, naive and competitive.",

    "abilityPower": 1.5,
    "armour": 3.9,
    "magicResist": 1.3,
    "attackSpeed": 0.036
  },
  "passive": {
    "brief": "Stronger near allies; a second skill stuns heroes.",
    "briefTags": ["Control", "Buff"],
    "_why": "Capped at five minions: a full wave is six, so the cap is reached in lane and not exceeded. An allied hero counts as two (2026-10-17) so he keeps the bonus in team fights, where there are no waves; in lane the wave already fills the cap.",
    "name": "Competitive",
    "timingNote": "The stun always takes a second cast. Every hit from the cast that marked counts as one, so a single Relentless or Retreat never stuns on its own.",
    "kind": "Rally",
    "perMinion": 0.06,
    "armourPerMinion": 4.5,
    "maxMinions": 5,
    "heroWorth": 2,
    "radius": 12,
    "_whyMark": "Second part, user-approved 2026-10-17 (\"bake it in\" to the passive): a skill hitting an enemy hero marks it for 5s (3s at first; lengthened the same day so a mark from Thrust outlasts Thrust's own 4-5.5s cooldown or a Retreat and can be used), and his next skill to hit it, any skill, stuns for 0.5s, at most once every 6s per hero (\"different skills i dont think it matters\"). Hits from the cast that marked do not count, so one Relentless or one Retreat never stuns by itself; it takes two casts, such as Retreat then Thrust (the coward's kite, fed by Retreat's cut to Thrust). The cast that uses a mark lays no new one, so Relentless's later strikes do not re-mark the hero its first strike stunned; his next cast can mark again. No mark is laid on a hero inside his 6s after a mark-stun, so a mark always means the next skill stuns (marks spent in the window for no stun read as the stun not working).",
    "mark": { "lasts": 5, "stun": 0.5, "stunEvery": 6 }
  },
  "q": {
    "brief": "Throw your sword through everyone in a line.",
    "briefTags": ["Damage"],
    "name": "Thrust",
    "timingNote": "He pulls the sword back for a quarter of a second before it flies, long enough for a sharp enemy to step out of the line.",
    "aim": "Skillshot",
    "cooldown": { "start": 5.5, "step": -0.3 },
    "cost": { "start": 40, "step": 5 },
    "_why": "Speed 135 makes it a snap, not a push; flight at full reach 0.38s to 0.13s, under reaction time. castTime 0.1 to 0.25 gives that dodge window back as the pull-back: cast start to full reach 0.48s to 0.38s.",
    "_whyRange": "Range 17 to 19 on request (2026-10-17), so after Relentless and Retreat he can step back a few paces and still reach. The aim line, the thrown blade and the hit all read this one number.",
    "range": 19,
    "castTime": 0.25,
    "damage": { "start": 90, "step": 36 },
    "adRatio": 1.0,
    "damageType": "Physical",
    "_whyBuff": "Buffed on request (2026-10-17): width doubled, radius 1.8 to 3.6, a 7.2-wide line that the aim line, the bolt and the hit all read, so they still agree; damage about 20% up, 75+30/rank to 90+36/rank and 0.9 to 1.0 of attack damage. It pierces, so it now hits most of a minion wave at once.",
    "radius": 3.6,
    "projectileSpeed": 135,
    "pierces": true
  },
  "e": {
    "brief": "Slash in front as you leap back.",
    "briefTags": ["Dash", "Damage"],
    "name": "Retreat",
    "timingNote": "No wind-up: the cut and the leap back happen in the same moment.",
    "aim": "Ground",
    "cooldown": { "start": 10, "step": -0.5 },
    "cost": { "start": 50, "step": 5 },
    "range": 9,
    "castTime": 0,
    "damage": { "start": 60, "step": 25 },
    "adRatio": 0.6,
    "damageType": "Physical",
    "radius": 8.25,
    "shape": "Cone",
    "angle": 140,
    "dash": 13.5,
    "dashSpeed": 40,
    "dashBackward": true,
    "_whyWave": "Added on request (2026-10-17): the slash's own curved edge carries straight on 4 past it, keeping the slash's width, 5 deep (3, then thicker on request to match the art's arc), with a slight 15% slow for 0.75s. It dealt 40% of the slash until the user asked for it to only slow, later the same day: it is reach on his escape, and the slow is for whoever chases him.",
    "wave": { "past": 4, "thickness": 5, "speed": 28, "share": 0, "slow": 0.15, "slowFor": 0.75 },
    "_whyHeroHitCuts": "Coward's kite (2026-10-17, user-approved): the first enemy hero the slash or the wave reaches takes 60% off Thrust's remaining cooldown, so the slowed chaser walking at him can be thrust at once. Once per cast, so a crowd does not wipe the cooldown. Thrust's range is untouched.",
    "heroHitCuts": { "skill": "q", "share": 0.6 }
  },
  "r": {
    "brief": "Leap in and strike in a flurry.",
    "briefTags": ["Dash", "Damage"],
    "name": "Relentless",
    "timingNote": "Once he lands he cannot move or attack until the last strike, about a second later. He holds the fifth strike for almost half a second to show off, where the others come a fifth of a second apart, and that pause is when he can be caught.",
    "_whyAim": "Aimed at the ground again (2026-10-17, user: \"change zachs r back to aimable not lock on\"). A drag aims the dash point; a tap on an enemy still makes it a locked dash that lands beside them. It was lock-on for part of a day and never shipped that way.",
    "aim": "Ground",
    "cooldown": [42, 36, 30],
    "cost": [100, 100, 100],
    "range": 25.5,
    "castTime": 0,
    "damage": [30, 45, 60],
    "_whyScaling": "Buffed on request (2026-10-17): 0.16 to 0.22 of attack damage per strike, base and ramp unchanged. At level 15 with about 210 attack, the full five strikes go from about 700 to 800 before armour, so the gain lands on a built Zach rather than on a fresh one.",
    "adRatio": 0.22,
    "damageType": "Physical",
    "_whyRadius": "Grows per strike since 2026-10-17, on request: 7, 7.75, 8.5, 9.25, 10 against a flat 8.25 before, about the same on average with a little more reach at the end, so someone walking out of the spin is caught by the wider later cuts.",
    "radius": 7,
    "pulseRadiusStep": 0.75,
    "dash": 25.5,
    "dashSpeed": 75,
    "pulses": 5,
    "pulseEvery": 0.2,
    "pulseRamp": 0.25,
    "_whyRamp": "Compounds since 2026-10-17, on request: each strike 1.25x the one before (1, 1.25, 1.56, 1.95, 2.44; 8.2 in all against 7.5 linear), which is what the tooltip always said.",
    "pulseRampCompounds": true,
    "holdsCaster": true,
    "_whyFinisher": "On request (2026-10-17): the last strike is loaded longer, 0.45s after the fourth instead of 0.2s, with the hold lasting that much longer and ending in the hit; it adds 40/60/80 base damage, before the ramp and ally boost multiply it (about 2.4x by the fifth strike, so roughly 100/145/195 more), and throws a ring wave out from its edge like Retreat's: 4 further, 5 deep, slow-only, 15% for 0.75s.",
    "finisher": { "damage": [40, 60, 80], "windup": 0.45 },
    "wave": { "past": 4, "thickness": 5, "speed": 28, "share": 0, "slow": 0.15, "slowFor": 0.75 },
    "comboRefund": 0.5,
    "_whyAllyBoost": "Shows off for an audience (2026-10-17, user-approved): 10% more per allied hero inside his Rally radius (12) as the cast starts, at most 40% with four. He fights alongside his team and is overconfident; the hold at the end stays as his flaw.",
    "allyBoost": { "perAlly": 0.1, "most": 0.4 }
  },
  "builds": [
    { "name": "Duelist", "items": ["Whetstone", "WardensTreads", "TempestEdge", "Bloodthirst", "Warmonger", "Bulwark"] },
    { "name": "Vanguard Blade", "items": ["Whetstone", "MysticTreads", "Bloodthirst", "Bulwark", "Aegis", "Warmonger"] }
  ]
}
